about: Real-shaped facts, and questions in other word forms that must find each one in the top three. A miss means search lost a word form or ranks filler. The last query shares only filler words with any fact, so it must find nothing.

facts.body: Probe every Worker route on the preview, not only the new one: a change to app/worker/ broke an old route once.
The session-start digest is capped at 40 lines and 6 KB, so the person's page and feedback keep room.
The owner wants short replies in plain words, with no tool names unless they ask.
Only the admin runs memory.mjs migrate; it applies each unrecorded migration file, then records it.
An offline write is spooled to a local file, and the next session start sends it through the gate.
Ship squash-merges the pull request after CI passes and the preview is checked.
A memory key ends after 30 days; the session-start hook renews it through GitHub before it expires.
Credentials sit in the git-ignored .env at the primary worktree; a key is received through a private link.
Each mini app is served at /apps/<name>/ from folders inside the main app.
Unverified: whether agents load a verb's open threads when that verb starts.
How should this be done? We would have to ask them about it, and then they could answer.
